def main():
    x = input().strip()
    if not x:
        print('')
        return
    y = x[0]
    at_done = False
    i = 1
    n = len(x)
    while i < n:
        if not at_done and i + 2 < n and x[i:i+2] == "at":
            y += '@'
            i += 2
            at_done = True
        elif i + 3 < n and x[i:i+3] == "dot":
            y += '.'
            i += 3
        else:
            y += x[i]
            i += 1
    print(y)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
